description: This Java class implements a method operation for the MiniLang language, specifically handling the <call-map-processor> element. It facilitates invoking external or inline map processors within the mini-lang framework, managing input/output maps and error messages.

classes.name: CallSimpleMapProcessor
classes.description: Implements invocation of external and inline map processors as a method operation within the mini-lang framework, managing input/output maps and error handling.

methods.name: CallSimpleMapProcessor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the processor operation based on configuration XML element, validating attributes and setting up map accessors.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the map processor, including external and inline processors, modifies maps, and logs errors.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the call-map-processor element with current attributes.
